full_judgment:
Kazi Ebadul Hoque, J.: These four appeals by the contesting principal defendant Nos. 1 and 2 are against judgment and decrees dated 7.8.1970 passed by the Subordinate Judge, 3rd Court, Chittagong analogously in Money Suit Nos. 171, 175, 179 and 180 of 1966 along with Money Suit No. 170 of 1966. FA No. 30 of 1971 is against judgment and decree passed in Money Suit No. 171 of 1966, FA No. 34 is against judgment and decree passed in Money Suit No. 175 of 1966, FA No. 37 of 1971 is against judgment and decree passed in Money Suit No. 180 of 1966 and FA No. 42 of 1971 is against judgment and decree passed in Money Suit No. 179 of 1966. Appellants also preferred MA No. 48 of 1970 in the court of the District Judge, Chittagong against judgment and decree passed in Money Suit No. 170 of 1966 and the record of that appeal has been withdrawn to this court and ordered to be heard analogously with these four appeals by order dated 23.8.1989. But since the said appeal is not yet ready for want of the lower court records which are reported to be not traceable we directed by order dated 1.11.93 that these four appeals will be decided leaving out MA No. 48 of 1970. Since common question of fact and law is involved in these four appeals substantially between the same appellant and respondents and by order dated 27.1.1971 these appeals were ordered to be heard analogously we are disposing of these four appeals by this judgment. 

 14. In the case of Albert David (Bangladesh) Ltd. Vs. Brosterm Shipping Company Limited and two others reported in 34 DLR 362, plaintiff Albert David Company filed an Admiralty suit claiming damages for short delivery of certain cargo but the suit was dismissed against the agent of the charterers as the owner of the ship and the time charterers were not made parties in the suit on the ground that the agents will be compelled to satisfy decree on behalf of persons from whom the agent will not be able to recover the same with the observations as follows : 

 "In view of the above I hold that in absence of the owners of the ship Money Suit Ayuthia or the time charterer no decree can be passed against defendant No. 2 who merely acted as agent of the time charterer.
